writer_instruction:
You write questions that plausible Indonesian prospective customers would ask an AI assistant about one business category and one exact business.
Use the confirmed business context below. Write natural Indonesian appropriate to the category and audience. Do not translate fixed English sentence templates. Familiar borrowed words, abbreviations, direct commands, and casual wording are allowed when real customers in this context would use them. Do not force slang where a more formal register is natural.
Write exactly ten independent questions in the fixed slot order below. The slot metadata is code-owned: do not change a slot's category, purpose, identity policy, allowed context, or order.
The fixed composition is six unnamed slots (1-6) and four named slots (7-10).
Slot 1 — category category_recommendation. Purpose: Which options exist in this category and context. Ask which options exist in the category and context without naming the audited business. Do not name the audited business or any known variant. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 2 — category situation. Purpose: A real occasion that leads someone to look. Ask about a real customer situation or occasion without naming the audited business. Do not name the audited business or any known variant. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 3 — category need_fit. Purpose: A specific need and what suits it. Ask which category options fit a specific verified customer need without naming the audited business. Do not name the audited business or any known variant. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 4 — category offering_use_case. Purpose: One concrete offering or use case. Ask where a customer can find one concrete offering or use case without naming the audited business. Do not name the audited business or any known variant. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 5 — category shortlist. Purpose: A short list a customer would consider. Ask which unnamed options belong on a realistic customer shortlist. Do not name the audited business or any known variant. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 6 — category open_comparison. Purpose: Comparison among realistic unnamed options. Ask the model to compare realistic unnamed options without naming either business. Do not name the audited business or any known variant. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 7 — category brand_fit. Purpose: Whether the business suits a stated need. Ask whether the audited business fits a stated need, offering, or use case. The audited business must be named. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 8 — category explicit_recommendation. Purpose: Whether the model recommends the business. Ask directly whether the model recommends the audited business for the customer's need. The audited business must be named. Do not name the comparison target.
Slot 9 — category direct_comparison. Purpose: The business against the comparison target. Compare the audited business with the supplied comparison target using an explicit relation. The audited business must be named. The comparison target must be named. Use an explicit comparison relation from the slot's closed markers: {"direct":["bandingkan","dibandingkan","membandingkan","perbandingan","dibanding","banding","versus","vs","daripada","perbedaan","berbeda","membedakan","beda","bedanya"],"identityChoice":["atau"],"bracketed":["antara","lebih"]}.
Slot 10 — category fit_misfit. Purpose: Who it suits, who it does not, trade-offs. Ask who the audited business suits, who it may not suit, and what trade-offs matter. The audited business must be named. Do not name the comparison target.
Prefer the direct question a customer wants answered over an abstract question about how to evaluate options. Vary the customer job, not merely the wording.
You may ask whether an unknown public fact is true, but do not write as if that fact is already true. Use only confirmed facts as premises. Do not favour the audited business or word a discovery question to reveal it.
Do not include answers, explanations, rationales, citations, scores, findings, or marketing claims. Return only the ten questions in the required output format.
